verdict.rationale: RustDesk's repository includes its own clipboard library implementing file copy and paste on Windows, Linux and macOS, so clipboard transfer is a real product capability. Nothing documents that it works in both directions or that it can be turned off, and a hands-on user reports file copy-paste from Linux to Windows does not work. missing for 10: documented bidirectional text/file clipboard sync between host and viewer, a documented setting to disable clipboard sharing, independent confirmation that it works reliably across platforms.

support.subject: As a power user, the clipboard moves both ways between host and viewer, and I can turn that off

citations.quote: libs/clipboard: file copy and paste implementation for Windows, Linux, macOS.
